verdict.rationale: Missive documents its own search: the command bar can search all messages, contacts, or messages inside a specific label. Search also has Type (Internal/External) and Date range filters. That covers basic filtered search, but the rest of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: search operators/query syntax, ranked or relevance-sorted results, evidence of speed, explicit coverage of full mail history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: The Type (Internal / External) and Date range filters in search no longer stay greyed out until you enter a search term.
you can search in all of your messages, in your contacts or in the messages inside a specific label.
